name: kg_close_state
description: Set end_date (and optional end_date_confidence / end_date_prose) on an existing State or Event node. Use when a residence / job / membership era ended. Refuses if the node is not type State or Event, or if it already has an end_date — pass force=true to overwrite (the prior value is captured in kg_revision_log so reverse is possible).

inputs.name: node_id
inputs.description: Existing State or Event node id to close.

inputs.name: force
inputs.description: Set true to overwrite an existing end_date. The prior value is captured in kg_revision_log.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Why the era ended. Goes into kg_revision_log.

outputs.description: {ok, revision_log_id, node_id} on commit; {ok, dry_run, before, after} on dry_run.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_close_state:
- node_id (required): existing State/Event node
- end_date (required, ISO date)
- end_date_confidence (optional, default 'operator_close')
- end_date_prose (optional)
- force (optional, default false): allow overwriting an existing end_date
- reason (required)
- dry_run (optional)
- finding_id (optional)
